title: {Syn} Delaunay Triangulation Avoids Skinny Triangles
content:
A Delaunay triangulation connects points so that no point lies inside the circumcircle of any triangle. It tends to avoid very skinny triangles.

That makes it useful in meshing, interpolation, computer graphics, and spatial analysis.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
